title: Shopping now starts with AI, and our store must be ready for it
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini; Amex added a framework to verify AI agent purchases. PC shipments fell 20%+ in Q3.

points.headline: AI discovery and agent checkout are going mainstream
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Shopify data shows AI discovery converts better. Google launched Universal Cart. We should make catalog data and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: Agent purchases are getting payment trust rails
points.detail: Amex introduced a framework so AI agents buy only what users authorize. Expect issuers to authenticate agent-made orders; we should prepare our store for them.

points.headline: PC demand is weak while memory costs climb
points.detail: Q3 PC shipments fell more than 20% year over year, while DRAM and NAND prices rise into Q4. We should plan holiday pricing, promotions and inventory carefully.

points.headline: Holiday demand is growing but shoppers are price-wary
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales, up 6.7%, yet shoppers distrust dynamic pricing and split into price camps. Segment offers and keep price messaging clear.

points.headline: Financing is shifting as Amazon UK adds BNPL
points.detail: Amazon expanded buy now, pay later in the UK via Affirm, while young consumers pull back from pay later. We should compare our instalment options for big-ticket PCs.
